name: client.test
info: Records a test called name. It passes unless fn throws or a client.assert in it fails.

name: client.assert
info: Fails the enclosing test with message when condition is false. Outside a test, records its own result.

name: client.global.set
info: Stores a Global variable: later requests in the workspace can use it as {{name}}. An object is written as JSON.

name: client.global.get
info: The Global variable called name, or null.

name: client.global.clear
info: Clears the Global variable called name.

name: client.global.isEmpty
info: Whether no Global variable is set.

name: client.log
info: Writes a line to the response's Log: the values joined by spaces, objects as JSON.

name: response.body
info: The response body: parsed JSON for a JSON response, otherwise its text.

name: response.headers.valueOf
info: The first value of the header called name (any case), or null.

name: response.headers.valuesOf
info: Every value of the header called name (any case).

name: response.contentType.mimeType
info: The response's media type, e.g. application/json.

name: response.contentType.charset
info: The charset from the response's Content-Type, if it has one.

name: request.variables.set
info: Sets {{name}} for this request only. An object is written as JSON.

name: request.variables.get
info: The value request.variables.set gave name, or null.

name: request.environment.get
info: The selected environment's value for name, private values included, or null.
